title: The TV Quiz Wall Now Walks Tomorrow's Timetable | vitalii.no
description:
A family's quiz wall and their calendar were telling two different stories about the same day — a kid could end up drilling a subject they didn't even have at school tomorrow.

The old wall picked subjects from whatever card happened to be next in the sliding deck, with no link to what any child would actually have in class the next day. The calendar and the quiz wall showed completely different pictures of the same day.

A new Preview BoardCard template and a sequence field on the board data now drive 'the walk': child by child, in calendar column order, each one's own next school day's subjects in real timetable order, falling back to a review mode when no class plan exists yet. A new focus prop on the calendar strip lights a glowing ring on whichever calendar tile matches what the wall is currently asking about, and a shared subjects module now centralizes which lessons — like PE or swimming — the wall skips entirely.

The quiz wall and the family calendar now point at the exact same subject at the exact same moment, and the nightly sync job widened from re-aligning one drifted schedule per tick to two, so drifted sets catch up to the real timetable faster.
